meta.name: hypothesis-generation
meta.description: Structured hypothesis formulation from observations. Use when you have experimental observations or data and need to formulate testable hypotheses with predictions, propose mechanisms, and design experiments to test them. Follows scientific method framework. For open-ended ideation use scientific-brainstorming; for automated LLM-driven hypothesis testing on datasets use hypogenic.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将观察转化为可检验的假设与实验方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有实验数据或观察结果，需要系统性地提出科学假设。
copy.tagline_en: Turn observations into testable hypotheses and experiments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have experimental data or observations and need to formulate scientific hypotheses systematically.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据你的观察或数据，系统性地提出多个可检验的假设，并设计实验来验证它们。
howto.when: 当你有实验观察或数据，需要形成可检验的假设并设计实验时触发。

say.text: 我观察到植物在红光下长得更快，请帮我提出几个可能的假设。
say.note: Claude 会生成多个竞争性假设并设计实验。

say.text: 根据这些基因表达数据，提出可能的调控机制假设。
say.note: Claude 会结合文献搜索提出机制性解释。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude systematically generates multiple testable hypotheses from your observations or data, proposes mechanisms, and designs experiments to test them.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have experimental observations or data and need to formulate testable hypotheses with predictions and experimental designs.

say_en.text: I observed plants grow faster under red light. Please propose several hypotheses.
say_en.note: Claude will generate competing hypotheses and design experiments.

say_en.text: Based on these gene expression data, propose possible regulatory mechanisms.
say_en.note: Claude will search literature and propose mechanistic explanations.
